heroHeadline: Brent Tops $109 Crisis-High as Aramco Suspends Yanbu Loadings and Libya Outage Compounds Saudi Pipeline Shock
heroSubtitle: A second Saudi supply blow -- Aramco halting Red Sea loadings at Yanbu -- landed alongside an unrelated Libyan field shutdown, pushing oil to the crisis's highest level yet before a surprise US inventory build pulled prices back Sep 16, with the East-West pipeline still shut and no confirmed repair timeline
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports (FAO, World Bank, IMF, IEA, WFP), major outlets (Reuters, Bloomberg, Al Jazeera, CNBC), and institutional analyses (Lloyd's List, S&P Global, IFPRI, Atlantic Council).
